items.question: Within how many days after the campaign closes are winners notified?
items.gold: Winners are notified within 28 days of the campaign's closure.
items.fact: Winners are notified within 28 days after campaign closure.

items.question: Can cashback awarded under this campaign be exchanged for cash?
items.gold: No, it cannot be exchanged for cash or any other alternative.
items.fact: Campaign cashback cannot be exchanged for cash or alternatives.
